about.bio: Hey, I'm Arian, a Software Engineering student and Web Developer. I love solving problems and building digital experiences that look great, feel right, and actually bring value to users and businesses.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.subtitle: Building high-performance web applications across enterprise platforms.

kanda.desc: The company works on large-scale projects in the oil, gas, petrochemical, and telecommunications sectors, and I am part of the team responsible for developing and maintaining a national mining management system. I have developed user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, and ASP.NET MVC, while also being responsible for product maintenance, improving the product by quickly fixing bugs and developing new features.

isiran.desc: At ISIRAN, I worked as a frontend developer on large-scale national education projects. I was responsible for designing the user interface using React and Next, and through continuous collaboration with the client, I gained experience building a major educational system.

mosbatesabz.desc: As an intern at Mosbatesabz, I started my journey in frontend development from the ground up, working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript while contributing to a real-world online pharmacy project. During this experience, I also became familiar with Scrum, daily stand-ups, and tools like Jira, gaining a better understanding of teamwork and agile development.

articles.desc: I’m grateful to share that our paper titled “A Comprehensive Review of Digital Twin Technology in Industrial Manufacturing Systems” has been accepted at the International Conference on Information and Telecommunication Technology (ITCT), to be held in Madrid, Spain (January 2026).
